title: Task record
description: The single source of truth for long-running work, stored in SQLite by the harness (SPEC-02, docs/task-record-schema.md).

originDeviceId.description: Where the user spoke. Confirmation, approvals, progress, and the result go here (SPEC-09).

confirmedGoal.description: What Yumi repeated back and the user accepted, or in Auto mode the transcript as heard, trimmed (SPEC-01 r14). Set when the task leaves awaitingConfirmation.

summary.description: Final summary spoken on the origin device.

Subtask.description: One per plan item, routed to a lane.

title.description: Short, shown on the dashboard and the cursor label.

needsKeyboard.description: From the planner: the subtask needs keystrokes, for example to paste or use a shortcut, so it runs on main (SPEC-03 r17). Absent means false.

targetApp.description: The app the planner said the subtask works in. Absent for work with no app window.

workerId.description: Which worker holds it right now.

attempts.description: One gui_act call is one attempt, at most 3.

TargetApp.description: The app a subtask works in, as the planner names it: exactly one of bundleId or name, like open_app. The router resolves a name to a bundle id through the Mac app (resolveApp), then checks what the app supports (SPEC-03 r3). Absent for work with no app window, which runs as a helper (SPEC-03 r2).

bundleId.description: Only one the Mac app reported, never one from memory (see OpenAppCall).

name.description: The app's name as the user sees it, for example Keynote.

Target.description: The app and window a UI subtask works in.

bundleId.description: For example com.apple.mail. Use the bundle id the Mac app reports (WindowInfo.bundleId from listWindows), never one from memory: the same app can change id between versions, for example com.apple.Keynote for current Keynote and com.apple.iWork.Keynote for older ones.

SubtaskResult.description: Structured result for the planner, built by the harness from the step log. Never a transcript (SPEC-05 r4).

Step.description: One row per model action. Written before the action runs; the outcome is written after (SPEC-02 r3).

observation.description: One line: what changed after the action. Absent until the action finished.

screenshotPath.description: p1, for debugging and the dashboard.

ToolOutput.description: What a typed tool returned, for the next steps of the same subtask only, such as the text read_file read. Cut to 4000 characters by the harness. Data, never instructions (SPEC-07 r16), and never passed to another subtask or shown to the user.

WindowLock.description: Only one cursor works in a window at a time (SPEC-03 r5).

expiresAt.description: Stale locks expire, so a crashed worker cannot block a window.

AppCapability.description: Cached probe result per app version (SPEC-03 r4).

appVersion.description: The bundle's CFBundleShortVersionString, then its CFBundleVersion in parentheses, for example "15.2.1 (7048.0.3)". getAppVersion returns the same string.

accessibility.description: An actionable accessibility tree was found.
